# RiskCalc

> Prop-firm & SMC risk management calculator. Compute exact position size for indices, crypto, forex, and commodities — designed for prop firm, SMC, and ICT traders. Know your exact size before you click buy.

RiskCalc (prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app) is a position-size and risk-management calculator for prop firm, SMC, and ICT traders. It converts risk percentage, account balance, entry price, and stop-loss into an exact position size in contracts, lots, or units — across major indices, crypto, forex, and gold.

## Core Use Cases

- Calculate exact position size from risk %, account balance, entry, and stop-loss
- Size positions for prop firm evaluations and funded accounts
- Preview risk-to-reward ratio with an optional take-profit level
- Size trades on indices (NQ, ES, US30), crypto (BTC, ETH), forex (EUR/USD), and gold (XAU/USD)
- Follow SMC/ICT risk management rules with precise contract math

## Supported Markets & Calculators

- [Nasdaq 100 (NQ) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/nq-nasdaq): $20 per point per contract position sizing.
- [Micro Nasdaq 100 (MNQ) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/mnq-micro-nasdaq): Micro contract position sizing for smaller accounts.
- [Bitcoin (BTC) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/btc-bitcoin): Crypto position sizing for Bitcoin.
- [Ethereum (ETH) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/eth-ethereum): Crypto position sizing for Ethereum.
- [Gold (XAU/USD) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/xau-gold): Gold position sizing with pip-based stop distances.
- [EUR/USD Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/eur-usd): Forex position sizing in lots.
- [S&P 500 (ES) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/es-s-and-p-500): $50 per point per contract position sizing.
- [Dow Jones (US30) Calculator](https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/us30-dow-jones): $5 per point per contract position sizing.

## Key Features

- Exact position size output in contracts, lots, or units
- Risk-to-reward (R:R) preview with take-profit input
- Pre-filled realistic entries and stop-losses for each market
- Correct contract specifications (tick value, pip size, precision) per asset
- Risk Management FAQ for prop firm rules
